hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"holy fuck, you talk a lot, more concise please"}}'

case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.go) command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && gofmt -w "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; command -v eslint >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null ;; *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ;; esac || true

echo 'BLOCK: Do not call MCP tools directly in the main conversation. Spawn a subagent (model: haiku) to run this MCP call and return a concise summary. This preserves context window tokens.' && exit 2
